entries.basis: All named states and row-subheaders have owned translated semantics and supported host actions. Native busy/error/retry cases verify one external live region, correct status/alert changes, retained rows/focus/two-axis scroll and sibling independence; reviewed images establish representative rendered states.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-G-15 Reconcile original `G-15`: Support empty, no-results, loading, refresh, error, and row-subheader states with appropriate announcements and preserved context. Historical status: open.

entries.basis: Public cells preserve adapter/native link metadata, escaping, date/timezone formatting and image fallback/replacement; retained tests cover original-row nested callbacks. Missing active Firefox clipboard receipt is now three passing native cases, including controlled error isolation and cleanup.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-G-21 Reconcile original `G-21`: Preserve link adapter semantics, visible focus, copy success/error feedback, escaped JSON/text, date localization, and image fallback behavior in cells. Historical status: open.

limits: Live-region assertions establish DOM/native contracts, not spoken output; representative speech remains X11. Clipboard failure case deliberately injects rejection and does not prove Firefox OS permission denial. Historical unit/native results retain original dates and inputs; no broad rerun or all-state matrix claim.
